title: Rollout choreography laneplan and checklist — wk13 2027 (sketch)
content:
Context:
This is a working sketch for a choreography-driven rollout ("laneplan") for the wk13 patch that bundles: routing policy tweaks, a small model-variant swap (quantized v2), and a backend KV-cache priming change. Purpose is to capture the operator checklist, ramp calendar, telemetry signals, and quick rollback triggers before we convert into the formal runbook.

High-level objectives:
- Push quantized v2 for short-context generation to lower p95 token latency by ~20% on dedicated nodes.
- Maintain tail latency and error budget across hosted API customers.
- Avoid cold-start regressions by priming KV cache and warming routes.

Week window (wk13): 2027-03-29 -> 2027-04-04
- Monday 2027-03-29: Preflight dry-run (internal staging).
- Tuesday 2027-03-30 10:00-14:00 PT: Canary launch (region us-west1).
- Wednesday 2027-03-31 09:00-17:00 PT: Horizontal ramp (us-west1 -> us-central1).
- Thursday 2027-04-01 08:00-20:00 PT: Regional backfill / burst window testing.
- Friday 2027-04-02 00:00-06:00 PT: Full traffic flip (if green).
- Saturday–Sunday 2027-04-03--04: Monitor/aftercare; optional rollback rehearsal.

Laneplan (phases + durations)
- Phase 0: Staging smoke and replay (24h before canary) — verify smoke tests, replay 3k synthetic requests across sequence lengths.
- Phase 1: Micro-canary (0.1% traffic, 1h soak) — check immediate errors and p99.9 spikes.
- Phase 2: Small canary (1% traffic, 3h soak) — telemetry baseline comparison vs control.
- Phase 3: Cohort ramp (5% -> 20% over 6h) — coordinate with routing policy to avoid saturating shared hosts.
- Phase 4: Broad ramp (50% -> 100% over 12h) — only if all gates pass.

Traffic split recipe (examples)
- 00:00 -> 00:05: 0.1%
- 00:05 -> 01:05: 1%
- 01:05 -> 04:05: 5%
- 04:05 -> 10:05: 20%
- 10:05 -> 22:05: 50%
- 22:05 onwards: 100%
(soak durations and timestamps are illustrative; finalize during preflight)

Smoke test checklist (staging -> canary -> ramp)
- Basic API sanity: text-generation, chat turn, embeddings.
- Latency assertions: median < baseline + 10ms, p95 < baseline - 10% target for quantized v2.
- Error rate: 5xx < 0.02% and not > baseline * 1.5.
- KV-hit-rate: after priming, kv-hit-rate >= 85% for warm cohort.
- Cold-start counter: no increase > 2x for cold-starts in first 2 hours.
- Output quality spot-check: run N=30 golden prompts; manual review for hallucination/regressions.
- Cost-sanity check: token compute per request within expected window.

Observability & telemetry hooks (telemetry sampling plan)
- Metrics to watch (per-route and global): p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth, token throughput (tokens/s), model-kernel-fallback-count, kv-hit-rate, kv-latency-ms, cold-start-rate.
- Traces: capture 1% full traces on canary traffic; 0.1% on control. Focus sampling on long sequences > 512 tokens.
- Logs: structured logs annotated with rollout_lane and model_variant tags.
- Alerts: temporary thresholded alerts for rollout window only (auto-snooze if lane passes).

Gates / pass criteria (must be green to progress)
- Gate A (micro-canary -> small canary): p99 < baseline * 1.2 AND 5xx < 0.05% over 1h.
- Gate B (small canary -> cohort ramp): no sustained error-rate increase, kv-hit-rate >= 80%, no p99 spikes > 2x for 3 consecutive minutes.
- Gate C (cohort -> broad ramp): p95 improvement or parity, resource saturation absence (GPU util < 90% host-level), no unexplained evictions.
- Final gate (broad -> full): 24h stable telemetry across us-west1 and us-central1 with all to-green status.

Rollback triggers (automated + manual)
- Automated: rolling 5xx rate breaching 0.2% for 10 minutes OR p99 > baseline * 2 for 10 minutes -> immediate rollback to previous model variant and routing policy.
- Manual: sustained customer complaints, critical customer impact flagged by CS, or control-plane instability.
- Emergency contact: pager rotation list in the runbook (sre@redwood, eng-release).

Operational playbook (quick steps)
- Before canary: tag the canary route with rollout_lane=wk13, provision isolated dedicated nodes for canary, run KV priming job (see playbook snippet below).
- Start micro-canary: update routing rule via orchestration UI (or infra API) with an explicit change window and runbook link. Announce in #release-ops Slack.
- Monitoring: run a dedicated Grafana dashboard for the lane with p95 annealing chart and an anomalies tracker.
- If Gate fails: incrementally cut traffic back to 0% then roll back model-variant and redeploy previous cache configuration.
- Post-flip: kick off quality sampling job (N=500 requests sampled across routes) and surface any regressions to Product.

KV priming recipe (short)
- Who: data-prep team (Marco lead)
- What: run prime_kv_batch with latest hot-prefix list (from /data/cache-hot-lists/wk13.csv) to warm prefix entries on canary nodes.
- How long: 15–30m depending on cluster size. Target kv-hit-rate >= 85% after run.

Open questions / risks
- Risk: quantized v2 occasionally exhibits rare CPU offload on host; need a quick pattern to detect kernel offload events. (action: SRE to add kernel-offload gauge to dashboard)
- Question: should we exclude SLA-sensitive customers from canary automatically or route them to control? (action: product to confirm exclusion list)
- Dependency: a separate infra PR (PR#1189) enables finer-grained route pinning; coordinate merge timing.

Communication snippets (for Slack/email)
- Preflight message (to #release-ops): "Starting wk13 laneplan dry-run in staging at 10:00 PT. Will exercise kv-priming and smoke tests. Watch rollout lane: wk13-staging. Links: <runbook> <dashboard>."
- Canary move message: "Launching micro-canary (0.1%) to us-west1. If you see >0.2% 5xx or p99 spikes, escalate immediately. Live dashboard: <grafana-lane-wk13>."
- Rollback notice template: "Rollback initiated for wk13 lane due to [reason]. Rolling traffic to previous variant; investigating."

Minimal ops checklist (copyable into runbook)
- [ ] Preflight smoke passed in staging (replay N requests).
- [ ] KV priming job completed and kv-hit-rate validated.
- [ ] Observability dashboard pinned and alerting configured for rollout window.
- [ ] Routing rule and change window created (incl. link to this doc).
- [ ] Oncall + release engineers present for start of canary.
- [ ] Customer exclusion list verified and applied.
- [ ] Post-flip quality sampling job configured.

Post-release notes (template; fill after release)
- Rollout date/time: 
- Model variant deployed: 
- Observed latency changes (p50/p95/p99): 
- Error-rate delta: 
- KV-hit improvement: 
- Notes on regressions and actions taken: 
- Follow-ups (owners + due dates): 

Appendix: quick diagnostic commands
- Check route split: infractl routing get --route lane=wk13
- Force rollback routing: infractl routing set --route lane=wk13 --split 0
- KV priming status: primectl status --job priming-wk13

Notes to self / TODOs
- Add model-kernel-offload gauge to the lane dashboard (SRE).
- Product to confirm canary exclusion list by 2027-03-29 EOB.
- Add a short A/B prompt-set for automated quality checks (Emily).
- Convert this sketch to formal runbook and hand to release-engineering runbook owner.

---
Working draft: informal phrasing, placeholders, and TODOs intentionally left. Use this doc to iterate with SRE and Product; final runbook will be shorter and prescriptive.
